chapter: Stuff Smith Trio and New York
title: Butter, Fletcher Henderson, and Eubie Blake's undimmed hands
summary: Butter's early career, then musicians who keep their ability, with Eubie Blake as the example.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
